_comment: TIER 3 slot. The status-surface files (server.py, index.html, icons, status-surface.md) ship on the stacked UI PR, which fills this folder. This manifest reserves the tier so presets.json can reference 'ui' and shipkit_init.py installs it once the files land. The UI consumes the status.json contract (lib/status.schema.md) + the inbox/drops/ steer path at runtime — it does NOT import lib/ Python. That makes ui a runtime-orders-after dependency on autonomous (status.json must exist), expressed here as requires[].
name: ui
